data.title: 空崎日奈 · 氤氲镜前的浴后吹发
data.description: 刚洗完热水澡的洗漱间里还浮着薄薄一层温润水雾，镜面边缘凝着细小水珠。日奈裹着紫滚边纯白华夫格浴巾赤足站在台盆前，一手抬起将湿润的银白长发拢向肩侧准备吹干，察觉镜中映出的身影后耳尖泛起浅红，轻声问你毛巾是不是拿过来了。
data.location: 薄雾未散的暖光洗漱间台盆镜前
data.action: 赤足立于雾气镜前抬手轻拢湿发，透过镜面微羞回望
data.lighting: 镜柜暖白柔光穿透轻薄水雾，映出润泽肩颈与发梢水光
data.camera: 平视中近景，水汽镜面营造柔和私密氛围
data.mood: 温润、微羞、松弛安心的日常亲近
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot before the softly misted bathroom mirror after a hot shower, Hina gathers her damp silver hair over one bare shoulder while beads of warm moisture linger along her collarbones. Her white waffle-weave towel piped in soft purple stays knotted neatly across her chest as she meets the viewer's reflection with a faint flush.
data.animaCaption: Before the misted bathroom mirror, she sweeps her damp hair over one bare shoulder with a faint blush.
data.nsfwProse: Warm bath steam softens her damp bare shoulders and collarbones above the securely knotted white waffle-weave towel.
